title: The Bride Had Receipts
logline: After her groom exposes their fake marriage at the altar, a humiliated bride publicly retaliates—only for his hidden evidence to turn the scandal back on her.
target_audience: US women ages 18–34 who engage with fast revenge dramas, public betrayals, fake relationships, and escalating cliffhangers.
hook: At the altar, Ethan drops Ava's hand and announces, “I never loved her. This marriage was fake.” She grabs the microphone before he can leave.
synopsis: Ethan exposes his relationship with Ava as a fake marriage on their wedding stage, expecting her to disappear in shame. Ava takes the microphone, displays their agreement, and releases a recording proving he planned to discard her. Her evidence forces an emergency board review, but Ethan produces a hidden page showing Ava proposed the arrangement first—and she warns that revealing why could cost him everything.
episode_goal: Have Ava seize control after Ethan's public betrayal, expose his fake-marriage scheme, and trigger a counter-reveal that threatens her revenge.
